verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a data collection and pipeline platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The MCP server lets external AI agents configure the pipeline and inspect Live Events, which is an adjacent agent-integration capability, not built-in AI insights from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
